datasets.name: kpi_totals
datasets.query: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN u.usage_unit = 'DBU' THEN CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END), 2) AS total_dbus, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN u.usage_unit = 'DBU' THEN CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) * COALESCE(CAST(p.pricing.effective_list.default AS DOUBLE), 0) * fx.usd_to_gbp ELSE 0 END), 2) AS estimated_cost_gbp, COUNT(DISTINCT u.usage_date) AS active_days FROM system.billing.usage u LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices p ON u.sku_name = p.sku_name AND u.usage_start_time >= p.price_start_time AND (p.price_end_time IS NULL OR u.usage_start_time < p.price_end_time) LEFT JOIN (SELECT rate_date, usd_to_gbp, COALESCE(LEAD(rate_date) OVER (ORDER BY rate_date), DATE_ADD(rate_date, 365)) AS next_rate_date FROM bronze_dev.raw_reference.fx_rates_usd_gbp) fx ON u.usage_date >= fx.rate_date AND u.usage_date < fx.next_rate_date WHERE u.record_type = 'ORIGINAL'

datasets.name: daily_dbu_by_product
datasets.query: SELECT usage_date, billing_origin_product, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN usage_unit = 'DBU' THEN CAST(usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END), 4) AS total_dbus FROM system.billing.usage WHERE record_type = 'ORIGINAL' GROUP BY usage_date, billing_origin_product

datasets.name: dbu_by_product
datasets.query: SELECT billing_origin_product, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN usage_unit = 'DBU' THEN CAST(usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END), 4) AS total_dbus FROM system.billing.usage WHERE record_type = 'ORIGINAL' AND usage_unit = 'DBU' GROUP BY billing_origin_product HAVING total_dbus > 0 ORDER BY total_dbus DESC

datasets.name: monthly_summary
datasets.query: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', u.usage_date) AS usage_month, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN u.usage_unit = 'DBU' THEN CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END), 2) AS total_dbus, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN u.usage_unit = 'DBU' THEN CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) * COALESCE(CAST(p.pricing.effective_list.default AS DOUBLE), 0) * fx.usd_to_gbp ELSE 0 END), 2) AS estimated_cost_gbp FROM system.billing.usage u LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices p ON u.sku_name = p.sku_name AND u.usage_start_time >= p.price_start_time AND (p.price_end_time IS NULL OR u.usage_start_time < p.price_end_time) LEFT JOIN (SELECT rate_date, usd_to_gbp, COALESCE(LEAD(rate_date) OVER (ORDER BY rate_date), DATE_ADD(rate_date, 365)) AS next_rate_date FROM bronze_dev.raw_reference.fx_rates_usd_gbp) fx ON u.usage_date >= fx.rate_date AND u.usage_date < fx.next_rate_date WHERE u.record_type = 'ORIGINAL' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

datasets.name: top_workloads
datasets.query: SELECT COALESCE(u.usage_metadata.job_name, u.usage_metadata.notebook_path, pl.name, u.usage_metadata.dlt_pipeline_id) AS workload_name, u.billing_origin_product AS product, ROUND(SUM(CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE)), 4) AS total_dbus, ROUND(SUM(CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE) * COALESCE(CAST(p.pricing.effective_list.default AS DOUBLE), 0) * fx.usd_to_gbp), 2) AS estimated_cost_gbp FROM system.billing.usage u LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT pipeline_id, FIRST(name) AS name FROM system.lakeflow.pipelines GROUP BY pipeline_id) pl ON u.usage_metadata.dlt_pipeline_id = pl.pipeline_id LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices p ON u.sku_name = p.sku_name AND u.usage_start_time >= p.price_start_time AND (p.price_end_time IS NULL OR u.usage_start_time < p.price_end_time) LEFT JOIN (SELECT rate_date, usd_to_gbp, COALESCE(LEAD(rate_date) OVER (ORDER BY rate_date), DATE_ADD(rate_date, 365)) AS next_rate_date FROM bronze_dev.raw_reference.fx_rates_usd_gbp) fx ON u.usage_date >= fx.rate_date AND u.usage_date < fx.next_rate_date WHERE u.record_type = 'ORIGINAL' AND u.usage_unit = 'DBU' AND COALESCE(u.usage_metadata.job_name, u.usage_metadata.notebook_path, u.usage_metadata.dlt_pipeline_id) IS NOT NULL GROUP BY workload_name, product ORDER BY total_dbus DESC LIMIT 10

widget.name: subtitle_text
widget.textbox_spec: DBU consumption and estimated cost (£ GBP) across all workloads. Prices from `system.billing.list_prices` converted using **live ECB daily USD/GBP rates** (weekend rates roll back to Friday). Rates sourced from frankfurter.app, refreshed daily.
